title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
prompt:
**Problem.** A string s per line (read until EOF). Print, per
line, the length of its longest palindromic subsequence.

**Constraints:** up to 50 lines; 1 ≤ |s| ≤ 2000; lowercase letters.

O(n^2) interval DP; the two-pointer greedy is the planted trap.

tests.name: pair
tests.hint: LPS of 'ab' is a single char.

tests.name: embedded
tests.hint: 'aa' is the LPS.

tests.name: no repeats
tests.hint: All distinct: LPS length 1.

tests.name: already palindrome
tests.hint: Whole string.

tests.name: lps load 0
tests.hint: Interval DP over 2000 chars — O(n^2) = 4M ops, fits; O(2^n) or O(3^n) enumeration times out.
